translations.web: Heap on the wood. Make the fire hot. Boil the meat well. Make the broth thick, and let the bones be burned.
translations.bsb: Pile on the logs and kindle the fire; cook the meat well and mix in the spices; let the bones be burned.
translations.kjv: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.
translations.asv: Heap on the wood, make the fire hot, boil well the flesh, and make thick the broth, and let the bones be burned.
